title: AFCON 2025 - Senegal come from behind to beat Sudan
summary: Aamir Yunis Abdallah shocked the Lions of Teranga after he fired in an early opener in the 6th minute. But Senegal didn't tremble and comfortably retook control of the game, as Pape Gueye scored a brace while Ibrahim Mbaye scored a final goal just minutes after coming on, set up by Sadio Mané, who now holds the record for the most assists in AFCON history.
